          <h3 class="category-title">Nonlinear Control</h3>
          
          <div class="resource-grid">
            <div class="resource-card has-media">

              <div class="resource-content">
                <h3>Nonlinear Systems</h3>
                <p class="book-authors">by Hassan K. Khalil</p>
                <p class="resource-description">
                  The most widely used textbook on nonlinear systems analysis and control. This comprehensive text covers 
                  stability theory, feedback linearization, passivity, and advanced topics in nonlinear control. Known for 
                  its clear exposition and extensive examples, it's an essential reference for students and researchers.
                </p>
                <div class="book-links">
                  <a href="https://www.amazon.com/Nonlinear-Systems-3rd-Hassan-Khalil/dp/0130673897"
                     class="resource-link"
                     target="_blank"

                     class="book-cover">

              <div class="resource-content">
                <h3>Applied Nonlinear Control</h3>
                <p class="book-authors">by Jean-Jacques E. Slotine and Weiping Li</p>
                <p class="resource-description">
                  A practical and accessible introduction to nonlinear control design. This book emphasizes geometric 
                  methods, feedback linearization, and sliding mode control, with numerous examples and applications. 
                  Particularly strong on Lyapunov-based design methods.
                </p>
                <div class="book-links">
                  <a href="https://www.amazon.com/Applied-Nonlinear-Control-Jean-Jacques-Slotine/dp/0130408905"

              <div class="resource-content">
                <h3>Nonlinear Control Systems</h3>
                <p class="book-authors">by Alberto Isidori</p>
                <p class="resource-description">
                  An authoritative graduate-level text on nonlinear control systems. This book provides a rigorous 
                  treatment of differential geometric methods, including feedback linearization, input-output linearization, 
                  and the theory of invariant distributions. Essential for understanding the geometric foundations of 
                  nonlinear control.

              <div class="resource-content">
                <h3>Nonlinear and Adaptive Control Design</h3>
                <p class="book-authors">by Miroslav Krstić, Ioannis Kanellakopoulos, and Petar V. Kokotović</p>
                <p class="resource-description">
                  This pioneering text introduces backstepping and other adaptive control techniques for nonlinear systems.

                <h3>Underactuated Robotics</h3>
                <p class="book-authors">by Russ Tedrake</p>
                <p class="resource-description">
                  A comprehensive open-source textbook on underactuated robotics covering algorithms for walking, running, swimming, 
                  flying, and manipulation. This book emphasizes exploiting natural dynamics rather than canceling them out, making 
                  it highly relevant for understanding biomechanical systems and efficient robotic control. The book is freely available 
                  online with accompanying lecture videos and software tools.
                </p>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  const booksHistoryList = document.getElementById('books-history-list');
  if (!booksHistoryList) return;

  function updateBooksHistory() {
    let history = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('affinedrift_books_history') || '[]');
    
    const currentPage = {
      title: document.title.replace(' - AffineDrift', '').replace('AffineDrift - ', ''),
      url: window.location.pathname.split('/').pop() || 'resources-books.html'
    };

    if (currentPage.url === 'resources-books.html') {
      history = history.filter(item => item.url !== currentPage.url);
      history.unshift(currentPage);
      history = history.slice(0, 10);
      localStorage.setItem('affinedrift_books_history', JSON.stringify(history));
    }

    if (history.length === 0) {
      booksHistoryList.innerHTML = '<li class="history-empty">No recent books yet</li>';
      return;
    }

    booksHistoryList.innerHTML = history.map(item => 
      `<li><a href="${item.url}">${item.title}</a></li>`
    ).join('');
  }

  updateBooksHistory();
});
</script>
